activity_text: Anti-Gram+ & Gram-, Antifungal, candidacidal, anti-sepsis, Antibiofilm
comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (31.48%) to bacterial BM1122 A: 12%, K: 15%. GRAVY: -0.968, mol Wt: 9107.258; mol formula: C396H636N106O127S4; mol ex coeff: 7512.5; pI: 9.6. Activity: recombinant peptide (rScyreprocin) is active against Gram- bacteria P. fluorescens CGMCC 1.0032 (MIC < 0.5 uM), P. stutzeri CGMCC 1.1803 (MIC 0.5-1 uM), S. flexneri CGMCC 1.1868 (MIC <0.5 uM), E. coli CGMCC 1.2389 or MC 1061 (MIC 2-4 uM), A-hydrophila CGMCC 1.2017 (MIC >15 uM), V. fluvialis CGMCC 1.1609 (MIC 1-2 uM), V. harveyi CGMCC 1.1593 (MIC 2-4 uM), V. alginolyticus CGMCC 1.1833 (MIC 4-8 uM), V. parahaemolyticus CGMCC 1.1615 (MIC 8-16 uM), Gram+ M. luteus CGMCC 1.634 (MIC <0.5 uM), M. lysoleikticus CGMCC 1.0634 (MIC <0.5 uM), S. aureus CGMCC 1.363 (MIC <0.5 uM), C. glutamicum CGMCC 1.2389 (MIC 2-4 uM), B. subtilis CGMCC 1.108 (MIC 1-2 uM), fungi C. neoformans CGMCC 2.1563 (MIC 1-2 uM), C. albicans CGMCC 2.2411 (MIC 2-4 uM), C. krusei CGMCC 2.1857 (MIC 8-16 uM), C. parapsilosis CGMCC 2.1846 (MIC 16-32 uM), C. tropicalis CGMCC 2.1975 (MIC 16-32 uM), P. pastoris CGMCC 2.2238 (MIC 4-8 uM), F. graminearum CGMCC 3.349 (MIC 8-16 uM), F. solani CGMCC 3.584 (MIC 8-16 uM), F. oxysporum CGMCC 3.6785 (MIC 16-32 uM), A. niger GMCC 3.0316 (MIC 4-8 uM), CGMCC 1.2389 (MIC 2-4 uM), A. ochraceus CGMCC 3.583 (MIC 4-8 uM), A. fumigatus CGMCC 3.5835 (MIC 2-4 uM), and N. crassa CGMCC 3.1604 (MIC16-32 uM). MBC values vary from the same to higher. Binds LPS, LTA, and PGN. Antibiofim:fungi:C. albicans: Antibiofim:fungi:C. neoformans: inhibited attachment and disrupted biofilms. MOA:bacteria:V. harveyi: permeated bacterial membranes. Recombinant production:bacteria:Escherichia coli BL21: two expression systems: (1) pET28a-scyreprocin expression vector, His-tag; (2) pGEX4T2 expression vector, Glutathione S-transferase (GST)-tagged. In vitro toxicity: not cytotoxic to AML12 and L02 cell lines. Animal model:fish:survival: reduced the deaths of Oryzias melastigma by 60% treated 2 hpi with a semi-lethal dose of V. harveyi. Synergy:AMPs:in vivo: combined treatment with rSCY2 can reduce the doseage of rScyreprocin without sacrifying survival rate. Gene Bank: view the deposited mRNA here at NCBI.
title: A Novel Antimicrobial Peptide Scyreprocin From Mud Crab Scylla paramamosain Showing Potent Antifungal and Anti-biofilm Activity.
